domain.compared_quantity: radius of the smoothed dM/dr peak and its inward drift
domain.observer: areal chart of the recorded coupled arm
domain.state: recorded station payload, no time step taken

method.shell_density: centred dM/dr of the recorded coupled_mass
method.why_smoothed: The oscillation audit measured ringing of one to three cells over much of this profile. A median window of fifteen cells sits far above that and well below the shell's own width.

scope_note: A construction check on recorded finite states. It does not measure the actual universe. The shell leaves the computed domain at the inner edge in every case, so what happens to it afterwards is not measured here.

separation.reading: Two knobs, and they do not act on the same quantity. The mass ratio sets the force balance found earlier in this line; in the mass geometry it changes almost nothing. The source strength scales the shell amplitude exactly, decade for decade. So the family separates a force question from a mass question rather than sweeping one dial.
separation.what_this_does_not_show: It does not show that the mass ratio is irrelevant. The mass ratio moves the radial and angular pressures, and therefore the balance wall and the force reach, both of which were measured and both of which do respond. What is insensitve to it here is the mass geometry alone.

what_this_measures: The geometry itself. In the PG chart the geometry is fixed by M(r), so the shape of dM/dr is the shape of the object. The force diagnostics in this line measure what the two pressures do; this measures where the mass is.
